name: browser-use
headline: visual guide for Claude Code with templates
short_description: Claude How To provides visual, example-driven guides for Claude Code, from basic concepts to advanced agents. It includes copy-paste templates for immediate value, benefiting operations teams. It connects to Claude agents and Python workflows.
author: luongnv89

sections.overview:
Claude How To is a comprehensive skill directory providing step-by-step visual guides for Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI agent platforms. It covers foundational concepts through advanced agent development with practical, copy-paste ready templates that enable immediate implementation. The skill integrates directly with Claude agents and Python workflows, making it valuable for operations teams automating tasks and building intelligent systems. Each guide includes hands-on examples and code samples designed for rapid adoption and seamless integration into existing workflows.
Automate team onboarding processes using memory and slash commands.
Enhance code quality by integrating skills and hooks for automated checks.
Generate API documentation effortlessly with predefined skills.
Implement DevOps practices by utilizing plugins and MCP for real-time data access.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/luongnv89/claude-howto`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
